## What's new in v2.0.4

- Added smooth in-player brightness and volume gestures, with dedicated left and right screen zones and clear feedback.
- Live channel browsing now opens by swiping up from the middle of the player, with updated on-screen guidance.
- Added true 4K hero trailer selection when a 2160p YouTube stream is available, plus more reliable native trailer diagnostics and fallback handling.
- Improved M3U playlist loading state, cleared completed progress notices, and added persisted Live/VOD item counts to playlist rows.
- Added Tamil, Chinese, and Vietnamese to the preferred audio languages and made long settings lists scroll correctly.
- Plugin repositories can now use manifest filenames other than manifest.json, including extensionless repository endpoints.
- Removed the shield icon from plugin source rows and corrected the Default Player label so Auto is displayed as Auto.
- Update prompts now wait until the user is inside the app past profile selection before appearing.
